category.instructions: Which inbox folder does this email belong in?

criteria.personal: a real person or a government office writing to me personally: family, friends, official paperwork
criteria.work: my employer or colleagues: tasks, meetings, internal company mail
criteria.money: bank alerts, bills, invoices, payments made, statements, subscriptions renewing
criteria.orders: receipts, order confirmations, shipping and delivery updates, package pickup
criteria.security: sign-in alerts, one-time codes, password or account changes, suspicious account warnings
criteria.jobs: job alerts, recruiters, job board matches, gig work offers
criteria.home: landlord, apartment building or community notices
criteria.newsletters: articles, digests, product updates, policy or terms updates
criteria.promotions: marketing, sales, deals, coupons, offers to buy or sign up
criteria.social: social network notifications: mentions, messages, posts from people I follow

phishing.instructions: Is this email a phishing or scam attempt to steal money, credentials, or personal data?

action.instructions: Does this email ask me to do something personally (reply, attend, pay, pick up, use a code)?
